Removing a download asks about its files with a switch, and deleting the files no longer needs a login password.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Removing downloads asks about the files with a switch.** It starts off, so the downloads leave the list and the files stay on disk unless you turn it on. With the switch on, the dialog says how many files and how much space go, and the button reads Remove and delete the files. Shift+Del and the menu entry of that name open the dialog with the switch already on.
- **Deleting downloaded files no longer needs a login password.** Only downloading a backup still waits for one, since it carries every password in the settings.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new switch and the dialog title are in all 43 languages.
